White Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I won this white emerald from a shooting gallery. I think it might have been dropped in there by accident, but I'm not one to question it. It's the fourth in its set, which I've heard make it especially valuable to some people.
White Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: I found this Chaos Emerald in a haunted castle full of potent magical energy. I heard someone is looking for their fourth.
White Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem, which I found in the ruins of a prison built on a remote island. All that's left there now is toxic waste.
White Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: If that someone already has three of them, you'd best hope they have good intentions. It could really go either way, with that sort of person.

Cyan Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I found this cyan emerald on the outskirts of a massive industrial base. I didn't like the look of the place, so I got out as fast as I could.
Cyan Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: This Chaos Emerald, along with several just like it, were once used to power the cannon of a massive space station. A misuse of its power, if you ask me. I hope you'll take better care of it.
Cyan Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: If someone's only idea for how to harness the power of a Chaos Emerald is to use it as a battery for a machine, they must not be very creative.
Cyan Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Take this gem. It almost matches the majesty of the massive airship which once contained it. Almost.

Red Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I found this red emerald by a computer terminal on a space station. But something tells me it's more than just a lost paperweight.
Red Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: This Chaos Emerald was in the middle of a military base. You look like you'd make better use of it, so I'll let you buy it if you want to.
Red Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: I wonder if we should be thankful those soldiers haven't made better use of such powerful artifacts...
Red Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem. I found it inside a large, mobile gambling device of some sort. I gave it a spin, but strangely, getting three symbols in a row just summoned a bunch of killer robots.

Green Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: I found this Chaos Emerald being guarded by a couple of alien troops. Woefully insufficient protection for such an important item
Green Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: I don't know why Black Arms aliens would lock a Chaos Emerald inside a cage, but such obstacles are trivial when you know teleportation magic.
Green Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem. I don't know why, but it has a powerful sort of feeling to it, which is why I swiped it when the soldiers guarding it were distracted. Maybe they got it from aliens or something?
Green Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I managed to trick some aliens into giving me this powerful-looking emerald by swapping it with a similar-looking rock. Not the brightest bunch, are they?

Blue Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I found this blue emerald lying in the street of a large city. I don't know who lost it, but finders keepers, I say!
Blue Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: You'd never believe the sorts of magical artifacts some people can misplace. I found this Chaos Emerald lying on the road!
Blue Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem, which I found in the streets of Westopolis. I suppose someone lost it amidst the chaos, but I couldn't find its owner.
Blue Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: You'd think in the midst of an alien attack, you'd want to hold onto whatever power you could.

Purple Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem. I found it in a base built inside a volcano. The place was hotter than my forge, but nothing I couldn't handle.
Purple Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: I found this Chaos Emerald in a comet which only appears once every 50 years. Strangely, even after I left, I felt like it was... watching me.
Purple Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: If anyone asks, you didn't buy this from me. Got it?
Purple Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I'm told the military was interested in obtaining this purple gem for one reason or another. I've got a bad feeling about that, so if you want to take it off of my hands for a few candies, I won't say no!

Yellow Chaos Emerald.sorceressPre: I found this Chaos Emerald in the middle of some vast, ancient ruins. There's something off about that place, but I didn't have time to investigate.
Yellow Chaos Emerald.sorceressPost: I might go back to have another look, sometime. There's as much history to that place as there is to that gem I sold you, so take good care of it.
Yellow Chaos Emerald.forgePost: Have this gem. I found this one hidden in the database of a government agency. Must be important if they hid it in cyberspace like that.
Yellow Chaos Emerald.merchantPre: I saw a small animal with a gun fighting a giant bull-like monster for this yellow emerald. I try not to ask questions, but I hope neither of them saw me take it while they were distracted.

Weapon:Pistol.hoven: I baked you a gun! I'm not sure what those do, but I heard someone say it can get you a discount at any store! Hope this helps you!

Weapon:Egg Bazooka.merchantPre: Despite this weapon's name, it doesn't actually shoot eggs.

Weapon:Omochao Gun.merchantPre: I'd be happy if you took this thing off my hands. It keeps giving me useless advice like 'Press the J button to jump!' Or 'Take damage and you'll lose health, so be careful!'
Weapon:Omochao Gun.sorceressPre: Is this annoying little machine what passes for a familiar these days? You'd be better off launching it at your enemies like a rock.
Weapon:Omochao Gun.forgePost: Take this strange gun, and never return with it. Weapons shouldn't talk. That's all I'm willing to say about that.
Weapon:Omochao Gun.hoven: I used the ingredients to create a helpful little friend who will give you advice! For example, did you know you can press the arrow keys to move in certain quests? I hope this helps!
Weapon:Omochao Gun.cyclops: Your reward is a strange little robot who will offer you tips when you need it. But be careful to not rely on walkthroughs for everything, or you'll forget the joy of solving puzzles.

Heal Units.sorceressPre: Inconvenient little devices that only work when thrown. Why not just use a potion?
Heal Units.sorceressPost: Here you go, but I urge you not to become reliant on it the way that the researchers aboard a certain space station have.
